newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 10.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 10.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The government insists that only small changes on the social security payment rules of enterprises are justified, although the employers regard the planned amandments as unsatisfactory.

- SZDSZ, the junior party in the ruling coalition diagrees with parts of the government proposal that in the future trade unions should delegate social security self-government members instead of election by the employees.
- The State Audit Office discusses today a draft report which criticizes the privatisation of steel industry in the Borsod (Northeast Hungary) region.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn has recovered from the flu and is likely to speak in parliament today.
- The Hungarian Radio interviewed President Arpad Goncz on the occasion of his 75th birthday.
